units.en: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,
units.literal: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,

units.zh: 獨立高山之頂，歡與麋鹿同羣，皦皦然絕其雰濁，誠恥之也，誠畏之也。」
units.en: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."
units.literal: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."

units.zh: 昉撰《雜傳》二百四十七卷，《地記》二百五十二卷，文章三十三卷。
units.en: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in 252 scrolls, and literary works in 33 scrolls.
units.literal: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in two hundred forty-seven scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in two hundred fifty-two scrolls, and literary works in thirty-three scrolls.

units.zh: 昉第四子東里，頗有父風，官至尚書外兵郎。
units.en: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.
units.literal: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：觀夫二漢求賢，率先經術；
units.en: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: In the two Han they sought the worthy and put classical learning first;
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Considering how the two Han sought the worthy, they put classical learning first;

units.zh: 近世取人，多由文史。
units.en: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.
units.literal: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.

units.zh: 二子之作，辭藻壯麗，允值其時。
units.en: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.
units.literal: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.

units.zh: 淹能沉靜，昉持內行，並以名位終始，宜哉。
units.en: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.
units.literal: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—they both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.

units.zh: 江非先覺，任無舊恩，則上秩顯贈，亦末由也已。
units.en: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.
units.literal: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, then high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.

units.zh: 戊子，立皇太子寶卷，賜天下爲父後者爵一級，孝子順孫、義夫節婦，普加甄賜明揚。
units.en: Day wuzi: Bao Juan was made crown prince; every man who stood as heir to his father gained one rank; filial sons, worthy grandsons, righteous men, and faithful widows were sought out, praised, and rewarded.
units.literal: Day wuzi: the crown prince Bao Juan was established; all who were heirs to their fathers received one rank; filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of righteousness, and chaste wives were broadly singled out, commended, and promoted.

units.zh: 己丑，詔「東宮肇建，遠近或有慶禮，可悉斷之。」
units.en: Day jichou: an edict said, "The heir's palace is new; gifts of congratulation from far and near are forbidden."
units.literal: Day jichou: an edict said, "The eastern palace is newly founded; distant and near may wish to send congratulatory gifts—all such are cut off."

units.zh: 年二十餘，依宋丹陽尹劉秉，秉誅後，事太祖文皇爲門下書佐。
units.en: Past twenty he served Song's Danyang administrator Liu Bing; after Bing's death he entered the founding Emperor Wen's gate as a Secretariat clerk.
units.literal: Past twenty, he attached himself to Song's Administrator of Danyang, Liu Bing; after Bing was executed, he served the founding Emperor Wen as a clerk in the Secretariat gate.

units.zh: 褚先生曰：臣為郎時，聞之曰田仁故與任安相善。
units.en: Master Chu says: When I served as a Gentleman of the Palace, I heard that Tian Ren had once been close friends with Ren An.
units.literal: Master Chu says: When I served as a court gentleman, I heard it said that Tian Ren had originally been on good terms with Ren An.

units.zh: 任安，滎陽人也。
units.en: Ren An was a native of Xingyang.
units.literal: Ren An was a person from Xingyang.

units.zh: 邑中人民俱出獵，任安常為人分麋鹿雉兔，部署老小當壯劇易處，眾人皆喜，曰：「無傷也，任少卿分別平，有智略。」
units.en: Whenever the people of the town went out together to hunt, Ren An would take charge of distributing the game—elk, deer, pheasants, and rabbits—among the hunters. He would assign the elderly and the young to the easier stations and the able-bodied men to the more difficult ones. Everyone was delighted and said: "All is well—Ren Shaoqing apportions things fairly and shows real shrewdness and judgment."
units.literal: When the townspeople all went out to hunt, Ren An would always divide the elk, deer, pheasants, and rabbits among them, and assign the old and young and the strong to the difficult and easy positions. Everyone was pleased and said: "No harm done—Ren Shaoqing divides things fairly and has wisdom and good judgment."

units.zh: 安以為武功小邑，無豪，易高也，安留，代人為求盜亭父。
units.en: Ren An reckoned that since Wugong was a small town with no powerful local families, it would be an easy place to distinguish himself. He settled there and took up a post as a thief-catcher at the local station, replacing the previous man.
units.literal: An considered that Wugong, being a small town with no powerful families, would be a place where he could easily rise to prominence. So An stayed there and took a position replacing someone as a thief-catcher at the local station.

units.zh: 後為亭長。
units.en: In time, he rose to become the station chief.
units.literal: Later he became station chief.

units.zh: 其後除為三老，舉為親民，出為三百石長，治民。
units.en: After this, he was appointed as a Village Elder, recommended for his closeness to the common people, and eventually sent out to serve as a magistrate at the three-hundred-bushel rank, governing the local populace.
units.literal: Afterwards he was appointed as an Elder, recommended as one close to the people, and went out to serve as a three-hundred-bushel magistrate, governing the people.

units.zh: 使任安護北軍，使田仁護邊田穀於河上。
units.en: He assigned Ren An to oversee the Northern Army, and dispatched Tian Ren to supervise the frontier agricultural colonies along the Yellow River.
units.literal: He sent Ren An to oversee the Northern Army, and sent Tian Ren to oversee the border agricultural colonies along the Yellow River.

units.zh: 是時任安為北軍使者護軍，太子立車北軍南門外，召任安，與節令發兵。
units.en: At that time, Ren An was serving as the Protector General dispatched to the Northern Army. The Crown Prince halted his carriage outside the south gate of the Northern Army camp, summoned Ren An, and presented him with an imperial tally ordering him to mobilize the troops.
units.literal: At that time Ren An was serving as the Protector General dispatched to the Northern Army. The Crown Prince stopped his carriage outside the south gate of the Northern Army camp, summoned Ren An, and gave him a tally commanding him to mobilize troops.

units.zh: 其後用任安為益州刺史，以田仁為丞相長史。
units.en: Subsequently, Ren An was appointed as the Regional Inspector of Yizhou, and Tian Ren was made the Senior Secretary to the Chancellor.
units.literal: Afterwards Ren An was appointed as Regional Inspector of Yizhou, and Tian Ren was made Senior Secretary to the Chancellor.

units.zh: 乃為衛將軍舍人，與田仁會，俱為舍人，居門下，同心相愛。
units.en: He then entered service as a retainer in the household of the General of the Guard, where he met Tian Ren. Both served as retainers under the same roof, and they became fast friends, united in heart.
units.literal: He then became a retainer of the General of the Guard, where he met Tian Ren. Both served as retainers, living under the same roof, and were of one mind in their affection for each other.

units.zh: 少孤貧困，為人將車之長安，留，求事為小吏，未有因緣也，因占著名數。
units.en: Orphaned young and mired in poverty, he drove a cart for a traveler heading to Chang'an and remained there, seeking a position as a minor official. Having no connections to rely upon, he registered his name on the rolls of a local district.
units.literal: Orphaned young and in poverty, he drove a cart for someone to Chang'an, stayed there, and sought service as a minor official, but had no connections; he then registered his name on the rolls of a local district.

units.zh: 坐上行出游共帳不辦，斥免。
units.en: He was convicted of failing to properly prepare the communal tent when the emperor passed through the area on a tour, and was dismissed from office.
units.literal: He was convicted of failing to properly arrange the shared canopy when the emperor passed through on a tour, and was dismissed.

units.zh: 下安吏，誅死。
units.en: Ren An was handed over to the judicial officials and put to death.
units.literal: An was handed over to officials and executed.

units.zh: 任安對曰：「夫決嫌疑，定是非，辯治官，使百姓無怨心，安不及仁也。」
units.en: Ren An replied: "When it comes to resolving doubts, determining right from wrong, evaluating the competence of officials, and ensuring that the common people harbor no resentment—in these things, I am no match for Tian Ren."
units.literal: Ren An replied: "In resolving doubts and suspicions, determining right and wrong, discerning the governance of officials, and ensuring the people harbor no resentment—I, An, am no match for Tian Ren."

units.zh: 書上聞，武帝曰：「是老吏也，見兵事起，欲坐觀成敗，見勝者欲合從之，有兩心。
units.en: When the memorial came to the emperor's attention, Emperor Wu declared: "He is a wily old official. When the fighting broke out, he wanted to sit back and watch how things unfolded, intending to side with whichever faction won. He harbors a divided heart.
units.literal: When the memorial reached the emperor's ears, Emperor Wu said: "This is an old and cunning official. When the military conflict arose, he wanted to sit and watch the outcome, intending to join whichever side prevailed. He harbors divided loyalties.

units.zh: 安有當死之罪甚眾，吾常活之，今懷詐，有不忠之心。」
units.en: Ren An has committed many offenses deserving death, yet I have always spared his life. Now he harbors treachery in his breast and is disloyal at heart."
units.literal: An has accumulated many crimes deserving of death, yet I have always spared his life. Now he harbors deceit and has a disloyal heart."

units.zh: 安拜受節，入，閉門不出。
units.en: Ren An bowed and accepted the tally, then entered the camp, shut the gates behind him, and did not come out.
units.literal: An bowed and accepted the tally, entered the camp, closed the gates, and did not come out.

units.zh: 任少卿曰：「某子甲何為不來乎？」
units.en: Ren Shaoqing asked: "Why has such-and-such a person not come?"
units.literal: Ren Shaoqing said: "Why has so-and-so not come?"

units.zh: 任安曰：「將軍尚不知人，何乃家監也！」
units.en: Ren An replied: "Even the general himself has no eye for talent—why blame the household steward!"
units.literal: Ren An said: "Even the general himself does not know men—let alone the household steward!"

units.zh: 於是趙禹悉召衛將軍舍人百餘人，以次問之，得田仁、任安，曰：「獨此兩人可耳，餘無可用者。」
units.en: Zhao Yu then summoned all the general's retainers—over a hundred—and questioned them one after another. He singled out Tian Ren and Ren An, declaring: "Only these two are fit for service. The rest are of no use whatsoever."
units.literal: Thereupon Zhao Yu summoned all of the General of the Guard's retainers, over a hundred of them, and questioned them one by one. He identified Tian Ren and Ren An, saying: "Only these two will do; the rest are of no use."

units.zh: 「提桴鼓立軍門，使士大夫樂死戰鬬，仁不及任安。」
units.en: "When it comes to taking up the drumstick at the camp gate and inspiring officers and soldiers to fight gladly to the death—in this, I am no match for Ren An."
units.literal: "In taking up the drumstick to beat the war drum, standing at the gate of the camp, and inspiring officers and soldiers to gladly fight to the death—I, Ren, am no match for Ren An."

units.zh: 武帝聞之，以為任安為詳邪，不傅事，何也？
units.en: When Emperor Wu heard of this, he suspected Ren An of feigning loyalty: the man had accepted the tally yet taken no action and reported nothing to the throne—why?
units.literal: When Emperor Wu heard of this, he thought Ren An had been feigning righteousness and had not reported the matter—why?

units.zh: 任安笞辱北軍錢官小吏，小吏上書言之，以為受太子節，言「幸與我其鮮好者」。
units.en: Ren An had previously flogged and humiliated a minor financial clerk of the Northern Army. The aggrieved clerk submitted a memorial denouncing him, testifying that Ren An had accepted the Crown Prince's tally and had demanded to be given "the freshest and finest goods."
units.literal: Ren An had flogged and humiliated a minor financial official of the Northern Army. The minor official submitted a memorial reporting this, saying that An had accepted the Crown Prince's tally and had said, "Please give me the freshest and finest goods."

units.zh: 楚誅其大臣郤宛、伯州犁，伯州犁之孫伯嚭亡奔吳，吳亦以嚭為大夫。
units.en: Chu executed its ministers Xi Wan and Bo Zhouli. Bo Zhouli's grandson Bo Pi fled to Wu, where Wu also made him a grandee.
units.literal: Chu executed its ministers Xi Wan, Bo Zhou Li, Bo Zhou Li grandson Bo Pi fled Wu, Wu also made Pi grand master.

units.zh: 越王句踐乃以餘兵五千人棲於會稽之上，使大夫種厚幣遺吳太宰嚭以請和，求委國為臣妾。
units.en: King Goujian of Yue then withdrew with his remaining five thousand troops to Mount Kuaiji. He had the grandee Zhong send rich gifts to Wu's grand steward Pi to request peace, offering to hand over his state and serve as a vassal.
units.literal: King Gou Jian of Yue then with remaining troops five thousand dwelt atop Kui Ji, made grand master Zhong thick bribes send Wu grand steward Pi to request peace, sought to entrust state as minister concubine.

units.zh: 夫差既立為王，以伯嚭為太宰，習戰射。
units.en: After Fuchai became king, he made Bo Pi grand steward and drilled his troops in warfare and archery.
units.literal: Fu Chai established as king, made Bo Pi grand steward, practiced battle archery.

units.zh: 而誅太宰嚭，以不忠於其君，而外受重賂，與己比周也。
units.en: he also executed Grand Steward Pi, because Pi had been disloyal to his ruler, accepted heavy bribes from abroad, and conspired with him.
units.literal: Executed grand steward Pi, because not loyal to their jun, outer received heavy bribes, with self formed clique.

units.zh: 吳太宰嚭既與子胥有隙，因讒曰：「子胥為人剛暴，少恩，猜賊，其怨望恐為深禍也。
units.en: The Grand Steward Pi of Wu already had a grievance against Zixu and therefore slandered him: 'Zixu is harsh and violent, shows little kindness, and is suspicious and malicious. I fear his resentment will become a grave calamity.
units.literal: The Grand Steward Pi of Wu already had a grievance against Zixu and therefore slandered him: "Zixu is harsh and violent, shows little kindness, and is suspicious and malicious. I fear his resentment will become a grave calamity.

units.zh: 前日王欲伐齊，子胥以為不可，王卒伐之而有大功。
units.en: Previously, when the king wished to attack Qi, Zixu said it should not be done; the king ultimately attacked and won a great victory.
units.literal: Previously, when the king wished to attack Qi, Zixu said it should not be done; the king ultimately attacked and won a great victory.

units.zh: 子胥恥其計謀不用，乃反怨望。
units.en: Zixu was ashamed that his counsel had not been accepted and therefore became resentful.
units.literal: Zixu was ashamed that his counsel had not been accepted and therefore became resentful.

units.zh: 而今王又復伐齊，子胥專愎彊諫，沮毀用事，徒幸吳之敗以自勝其計謀耳。
units.en: Now that the king is attacking Qi again, Wu Zixu stubbornly remonstrates, obstructs affairs, and hopes only for Wu's defeat so that his own plans may be proved right.
units.literal: Now king again attack Qi, Wu Zixu obstinate strong remonstrated, obstructed destroyed affairs, vainly hoped Wu defeat to self win his plan.

units.zh: 今王自行，悉國中武力以伐齊，而子胥諫不用，因輟謝，詳病不行。
units.en: Now the king is going in person, using all the state's military strength to attack Qi. When Wu Zixu's remonstrations were not accepted, he withdrew, made excuses, feigned illness, and refused to go.
units.literal: Now king personally go, all state midst martial strength attack Qi, Wu Zixu remonstrated not used, because stopped declined, pretended ill not go.

units.zh: 王不可不備，此起禍不難。
units.en: Your Majesty must be on guard. It would not be difficult for him to raise disaster.
units.literal: King cannot not prepare, this raise calamity not difficult.

units.zh: 且嚭使人微伺之，其使於齊也，乃屬其子於齊之鮑氏。
units.en: Moreover, Pi made people secretly spy on him. When he was envoy to Qi, he entrusted his son to the Bao clan of Qi.
units.literal: Moreover, Pi made person secretly spy him, his envoy to Qi, entrusted his son to Qi Bao clan.

units.zh: 夫為人臣，內不得意，外倚諸侯，自以為先王之謀臣，今不見用，常鞅鞅怨望。
units.en: As a minister, he is discontent at home and relies abroad on the feudal lords. He considers himself a strategist of the former king, and now that he is not being used, he is constantly resentful.
units.literal: Being person minister, inner not content, outer relied feudal lords, self considered former king strategist, now not seen used, often vexed resented.

units.zh: 願王早圖之。」
units.en: I hope Your Majesty will make plans against him early.'
units.literal: Wish king early plan it."

units.zh: 闔廬立三年，乃興師與伍胥、伯嚭伐楚，拔舒，遂禽故吳反二將軍。
units.en: Three years after Helü was established, he raised troops and with Wu Zixu and Bo Pi attacked Chu. He captured Shu and captured the two former Wu generals who had rebelled.
units.literal: Helü established three years, raised troops with Wu Zixu, Bo Pi attacked Chu, captured Shu, captured former Wu rebel two generals.

units.zh: 吳王不聽，用太宰嚭計，與越平。
units.en: The Wu king did not listen and used Grand Steward Pi's plan to make peace with Yue.
units.literal: Wu king not listened, used grand steward Pi plan, made peace with Yue.

units.zh: 其後四年，吳王將北伐齊，越王句踐用子貢之謀，乃率其眾以助吳，而重寶以獻遺太宰嚭。
units.en: Four years later, when the Wu king was about to attack Qi to the north, King Goujian of Yue used Zi Gong's strategy. He led his multitudes to help Wu and offered heavy treasures to Grand Steward Pi.
units.literal: Its after four years, Wu king will north attack Qi, King Gou Jian of Yue used Zi Gong strategy, led his multitudes help Wu, heavy treasures offered grand steward Pi.

units.zh: 太宰嚭既數受越賂，其愛信越殊甚，日夜為言於吳王。
units.en: Grand Steward Pi, having several times received Yue's bribes, loved and trusted Yue extremely. Day and night he spoke on their behalf to the Wu king.
units.literal: Grand steward Pi already several received Yue bribes, loved trusted Yue extremely, day night spoke at Wu king.

units.zh: 吳王信用嚭之計。
units.en: The Wu king trusted and used Pi's plans.
units.literal: Wu king trusted used Pi plan.

units.zh: 讒臣嚭為亂矣，王乃反誅我。
units.en: The slanderous minister Pi has caused disorder. The king instead executes me.
units.literal: Slander minister Pi made chaos, king instead executed me.

units.zh: 稚季者大俠，與衛尉淳于長、大鴻臚蕭育等皆厚善。
units.en: Du Zhiji was tied to Chunyu Zhang and Xiao Yu.
units.literal: Zhiji was a great bravo, thick with Commandant of the Guards Chunyu Zhang and grand herald Xiao Yu.

units.zh: 會淳于長敗，寶與蕭育等皆坐免官。
units.en: Chunyu Zhang's fall swept Sun Bao and Xiao Yu out with him.
units.literal: When Chunyu Zhang fell, Bao and Xiao Yu and others were all dismissed for implication.

units.zh: 太子曰：「顏子縮屋稱貞，柳下嫗而不亂，未若此翁白首不娶者也。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui was praised for chastity though he lived in a hovel, and Liu Xiahui kept his integrity though he shared a blanket with a woman—but neither can match this old man who has never married even to white hair."
units.literal: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui, who shrank in his hut, was called chaste; Liu Xiahui, who shared a blanket with a woman, was not corrupted—yet neither equals this old man, white-haired and never married."

units.zh: 昔豫子吞炭壞形以奉見異，齊客隕首公門以報恩施，知氏、孟嘗猶有死士，何況將軍之門！」
units.en: Yurang disfigured himself with charcoal for his lord; a Qi retainer dashed out his brains at the gate to repay a kindness. Even the houses of Zhi Bo and Lord Mengchang kept men willing to die—how much more may your own gate command such loyalty!"
units.literal: Anciently Yuzi swallowed charcoal and ruined form to serve and show strangeness; a Qi guest dashed out brains at the ducal gate to repay grace shown; the Zhi clan and Lord Mengchang still had death-sworn men—how much more the general's gate!"
